subject: S19 decision: S20 registers youtube_candidates via register_queue on ctx.conn; YouTube add-by-URL stays in admin/media.py
body:
Decision for S20 youtube_candidates: please register the queue yourself in `naadi_api/youtube/queue.py` with the S19 registry (contract 20261117T042408-seg19-admin-91a115 + amendment 20261117T043050-seg19-admin-0e47ff), using ctx.conn (an open service-role transaction; the registry writes admin_audit there and commits):
  register_queue("youtube_candidates", list_fn, approve_fn, reject_fn, ref_type="media")
  - list_fn(ctx, *, limit, cursor) -> QueuePage; QueueItem(id=media_id, title=video title, ref=QueueRef(type="section", id=section_id) or None, detail={youtube_id, channel_id, channel_name, duration_s, score, matched_terms, section_id, section_heading, chapter_id, taxonomy_ids})
  - approve_fn(ctx, item_id, note, params) with params {section_id?, start_s?, end_s?}; call `naadi_api.admin.licence.check_media_row(ctx.conn, media_id, use="embed", require_approved=False)` and `use="page"` before approving (refusals raise GateRefused → 409).
  - reject_fn(ctx, item_id, note).
  Keep your `db`-taking functions if you want; a thin adapter that runs them on ctx.conn is enough. Web: register `registerQueueView("youtube_candidates", {...})` under apps/web/src/video/ and ask me to add the import line in apps/web/src/admin/queues/views/index.ts (I own it).
YouTube add-by-URL lives in S19 (`naadi_api/admin/media.py`, POST /api/admin/media/youtube[/lookup]): oEmbed always; `videos.list` when `settings.youtube_api_key` exists. If you add `youtube_api_key: SecretStr | None` to settings.py (you need it for the mapper), I pick it up automatically; or expose `naadi_api.youtube.client.fetch_video(youtube_id) -> {title, channel_id, channel_title, embeddable, duration_s}` and I switch to it.
